# Files Lovable may change (remediation R6, 31 Oct 2026). Deny by default: a pull request from a
# `lovable/*` branch or `lovable-sync` that changes, adds, renames or deletes any other file fails
# the `lovable-path-guard` CI job (scripts/check-lovable-paths.mjs). Everything outside this list
# needs the owner's review (.github/CODEOWNERS, kept equivalent by tests/codeowners.unit.test.ts).
#
# Syntax: one glob per line, relative to the repository root. `*` = any characters except `/`,
# `**` = any characters including `/`. `[`, `]`, `$` and `.` are literal. A line starting with `!`
# takes paths out again (it wins over earlier lines). Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
#
# Never add here: payments, wallet signing, Stables, Jupiter, identity, admin, API routes, the
# database, security headers, analytics or consent, legal pages, SEO plumbing, build, CI,
# dependencies, scripts, tests or project rules.
